subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A museum showed a suitcase carried by a family who had moved across the sea.”?
options: Inside were clothes, letters, a cooking pot, and one toy.
The child had come only to get a toy back.
The hand was not a toy, though it looked simple.
Inside were old desks, stamps, signs, and waiting-room benches.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Inside were clothes, letters, a cooking pot, and one toy.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The child had come only to get a toy back.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The hand was not a toy, though it looked simple.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Inside were old desks, stamps, signs, and waiting-room benches.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Inside were clothes, letters, a cooking pot, and one toy.」，答案為「Inside were clothes, letters, a cooking pot, and one toy.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Inside were clothes, letters, a cooking pot, and one toy.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
